title: Shared definitions
description: Shared strategy/task/batch building blocks: flow control, output routing, per-flow dynamic values, tuple pools, worker binding. Single truth for these shapes; REST, MCP and frontend descriptions derive from here.

flow_control.title: Flow control
flow_control.description: Quantity or rate envelope. Strategy level sets the template's own envelope; task level caps the aggregate without rewriting strategies.

type.title: Flow control type
type.description: flows = flow count, bps = bits per second, time = seconds.

value.title: Flow control value
value.description: Flow count, bits per second, or seconds. Must be positive.

output_config.title: Output configuration
output_config.description: Where generated packets go: a port group for wire replay, or a pcap file. interface2 enables dual-port replay.

dynamic_value.title: Per-flow dynamic value
dynamic_value.description: How a per-flow field varies across flows of one template. Flow i resolves deterministically (rand uses seed+i, wraps at range end). Matches StrategyConfig semantics in internal/core (tuple_generator.go, shard_router.go).

strategy.title: Variation strategy
strategy.description: fixed = constant, inc = step through range, rand = seeded random in range, list = rotate entries, pattern = substitute {n} from range.

value.title: Fixed value
value.description: Constant for fixed strategy (string, number, or boolean).

step.title: Increment step
step.description: Step for inc strategy. Non-positive falls back to 1.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Seed for rand strategy; same seed+index yields the same value.

pattern.title: Pattern template
pattern.description: Template with {n} placeholder for pattern strategy.

list.title: Rotation list
list.description: Entries rotated per flow for list strategy.

tuple_config.title: Tuple pool
tuple_config.description: Four-tuple generation pool for batch classes. Each endpoint accepts a static value or a dynamic_value object.

src_ip.title: Source IP pool
src_ip.description: Source IPv4 pool: static address or dynamic_value.

dst_ip.title: Destination IP pool
dst_ip.description: Destination IPv4 pool: static address or dynamic_value.

src_port.title: Source port pool
src_port.description: Source port pool: static 0-65535 or dynamic_value.

dst_port.title: Destination port pool
dst_port.description: Destination port pool: static 0-65535 or dynamic_value.

group_id.title: Worker binding
group_id.description: Routes flows with the same generated id to one PacketWorker, preserving cross-flow timing (e.g. signaling plus data). Same dynamic_value semantics.
